title: a colour-scheme question nested inside a style rule is answered landside like its top-level twin

interactions.name: colour-scheme questions are answered before they cross

interaction.reason: collectRules resolves top-level media queries but pushes a nested rule's cssText whole, question intact

notes: both harness browsers answer the question identically (light), so the computed dimensions cannot see this; the delivered stylesheet's text can, which is what the assertion reads
